scope: Read-only viewer, no uploader or gateway behavior changes
volume_metric: Live retained messages acknowledged in trailing 60 seconds, new accepted separate from already_processed
units: records[] elements; decimal MB original logical-message JSON
coverage_limit: Archive recovery record/byte ACK volumes unavailable from current status/retention
checks: ACK time used instead of source creation time
Per-stream and S2-substream records and bytes reconcile
Already-processed excluded from new acceptance totals
Scan timeout and byte limits display unavailable instead of partial zero
